name: Old Rod
description: A basic fishing rod. Enables spawning of common fishes in aquatic biomes.

name: Good Rod
description: A decent fishing rod. Enables spawning of uncommon and rare fishes.

name: Super Rod
description: The best fishing rod. Enables spawning of epic and mythical fishes.

name: Sitrus Berry
description: Restores 25% HP when HP falls below 50%.

name: Leftovers
description: Restores a small amount of HP every turn.

name: Life Orb
description: Boosts damage but drains some HP each attack.

name: Focus Sash
description: Prevents a 1-hit KO if at full HP.

name: Choice Band
description: Greatly boosts Attack but locks you into one move.

name: Choice Specs
description: Greatly boosts Power but locks you into one move.

name: Choice Scarf
description: Greatly boosts Speed but locks you into one move.

name: Capture Net
description: A basic net for capturing wild animals. Standard success rate.

name: Great Net
description: A high-quality net that provides a 1.5x catch rate.

name: Ultra Net
description: An elite net with a 2.0x catch rate, perfect for rare finds.
